pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Zaitsev, 12.a4 h6 13.Bc2
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...exd5 answer d5, a capture the e5-pawn cannot make; plan 2 said d5 opens the centre. Rewrote plans 2 and 4 (first plan 4 rewrite rejected for saying the f8-bishop guards e5; corrected and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Zaitsev, 12.a4 h6 13.Bc2 exd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 used an open d-file with the pawns on d4 and d6 and an R(e1)-d1 notation; plan 2 gave ...Nb6, which no knight can reach. Rewrote plans 1-2 around 14.cxd4 Nb4. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed, Smyslov Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with no knight on f1; plan 2 gave ...d5 and ...Nb8-d7 with the knight on c6; plan 3 had ...g5 to challenge the f3-knight instead of the real point of 9...h6. Rewrote plans 1-3.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Smyslov, 10.d4
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave the knight route ending on e3 that the board did not allow; plan 2 called ...d5 the liberating break; plan 3 pushed f4 through the f3-knight. Rewrote plans 1-3.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Smyslov, 10.d4 Re8
pages.notes: Plan 3 gave ...Nb8-d7 with the knight on c6 (first rewrite rejected for saying the f8-bishop holds e5; corrected and accepted). Rewrote plan 3.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Smyslov, 10.d4 Re8 11.a4
pages.notes: Plan 2 gave ...Nbd7 and ...Nf8-g6 with no knights on b8 or f8; plan 4 said ...Bd7 meets axb5 and blunts the bishop. Rewrote plans 2 and 4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Smyslov, 10.d4 Re8 11.Nbd2
pages.notes: Overview called ...h6 a stop to a Bg5 pin that does not exist; plan 1 gave a route ending on e3; plan 2 gave ...Nb8-d7 with the knight on c6. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Smyslov, 12.Bc2
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Nf1-g3 with the knight on d2; plan 2 gave ...Na5-c4 and the route ...Nb8-d7-f8-g6. Rewrote plans 1-2. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Smyslov, 12.Nf1 Bb7
pages.notes: Overview (Bg5 'pin') and plan 1 (route ending on e3) fixed and accepted. Plan 2 calls the e8-rook and b7-bishop a battery on e4, but the e5-pawn and c6-knight block both; two rewrites rejected (the rook only reaches e4 after ...exd4, not after ...cxd4), so the old text is kept with British spelling only.

pages.name: Spanish: Closed, Smyslov, 12.Nf1 Bd7 13.Ng3 Na5 14.Bc2 c5
pages.notes: Overview called the game a fight for d5; plan 2 gave ...c5-c4 and a knight to c6 in an unclear order (first rewrite rejected because ...Qc7 does not bear on d4; corrected and accepted); plan 1 was vague about the kingside. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2. British spelling.
